subject: Prod readiness milestone alignment and ship-window proposal
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme-analytics.com>, procure@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prod readiness milestone alignment and ship-window proposal

Team —

Quick sync: after the internal product review and the last infra runbook read-through, I’m proposing we target a conservative ship window of Oct 18–20 for the first gated production push (non-tenant impacting feature flip). Before I lock this in, I need: 

- confirmation of blockers that would push that window (engineering/infra)
- enablement readiness (training slots, customer-facing docs, examples)
- a single owner for docs + one owner for rollout ops

I attached the latest milestone spreadsheet and the enablement owners doc. Please reply with your status and any hard blockers by EOD Wed (Oct 7).

Lina/Procurement — looping you in so Acme sees the tentative window and we can align on any procurement/contract gating.

Primary asks:
- Marcus: can you own the public docs and sample requests?
- Neha: can you confirm enablement session dates and trainers?
- Laura/Vivek: any infra or SRE objections to the Oct 18–20 window?

If there are serious objections we’ll move the window, but I want a clear list of what would force that.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Product Lead, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prod-readiness-milestones_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), enablement-owners_v2.docx (ownership matrix)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod readiness milestone alignment and ship-window proposal

Thanks Rachel — quick updates from Enablement: 

- We can staff two trainer-led sessions the week of Oct 11 (Thu/Fri) and public office hours the week of Oct 18. I need final docs and example prompts by Oct 9 COB to prepare slides and labs.
- We should run a dry-run with Sales/CS on Oct 14 morning (30-45m) — recommend Marcus + one eng for live Q&A.

Blockers/risks:
- If docs are still draft by Oct 10, we should push the ship window one week to allow for lab stability and recorded session production.
- Training environment access for a subset of Acme testers depends on infra creating a temporary demo tenant (Laura) — ETA requested.

I’ll hold the trainer slots tentatively; will confirm once docs + demo tenant are confirmed.

—Neha
Enablement Manager

Subject: Re: Prod readiness milestone alignment and ship-window proposal

I can own docs. I’ll take the following deliverables and due dates: 

- Public quickstart + API examples: draft by Oct 8, final by Oct 11
- Migration & rollback runbook (ops): draft Oct 9, final Oct 12
- Release notes + known limitations: Oct 12

Requests from docs team: 
- Please provide the finalized API surface and the canonical sample prompts (even if short) by Oct 7 COB. Those are blockers for the quickstart and example notebooks.
- Do we have a list of initial customers (like Acme) who will receive access on day 1? I’d like to add any customer-specific notes.

I attached a short outline (docs-outline.pdf) with page assignments. If anyone wants to swap ownership on a page, speak now.

—Marcus
Staff Technical Writer, DevDocs

Cc: procure@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod readiness milestone alignment and ship-window proposal

Thanks for the heads-up, Rachel. A few items from Acme’s side:

- Procurement: our internal PO process needs a final invoice and SOW by Oct 13 to meet internal fiscal cutoffs. Can BlueSky/Redwood confirm an invoice timeline? (cc’ing Orion from BlueSky Sales)
- Compliance: we need confirmation on data residency and audit logs (SOC2 evidence). If you can send the SOC2 report + log retention policy it would help speed review.
- Access: demo tenant for our pilot testers will need IP allow-listing. We’ll send the IP block by Oct 8.

If Oct 18–20 is confirmed, can we get a short timeline of what happens on day 1 vs day 2 (so our CS team can plan outreach)?

—Lina Gomez
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Analytics

Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod readiness milestone alignment and ship-window proposal

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Tentative ship window: Oct 18–20 (final confirmation pending: demo tenant and SOC2 evidence).
2) Docs: Marcus will own public quickstart + API examples; Marcus to deliver drafts by Oct 8 and finals by Oct 11. Marcus: please add an \"Acme pilot appendix\" once Lina shares any customer-specific notes.
3) Enablement: Neha to run trainer-led sessions Oct 11 (dry-run) and Oct 18 office hours; she needs final docs by Oct 9 COB to proceed.
4) Infra: Laura/Vivek to confirm demo tenant provisioning by Oct 8; if not provisioned by EOD Oct 8 we move the ship window +7 days.
5) Procurement/Compliance: Rachel to upload SOC2/retention docs to the Confluence page and share invoice template. Acme to confirm IP allow-list by Oct 8.

Action owners and deadlines:
- Marcus Lin: docs drafts Oct 8 (owns: prod-readiness pages, examples)
- Neha Kapoor: confirm trainers & schedule dry-run Oct 14, confirm office hours Oct 18
- Laura Bennett / Vivek Kulkarni: demo tenant by Oct 8 or escalate to infra team lead
- Rachel Kim: upload SOC2 evidence + invoice template to Confluence by Oct 7 EOD

If any owner cannot hit their date, mark it here and notify me immediately so we can either reassign or adjust the ship window.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the Oct 14 dry-run and a brief confluence page update.

Rachel Kim
Product Lead, Platform
Redwood Inference
